name: DopaDopa
tagline: Quick two-player board games with friends, online or on one phone
description:
DopaDopa is a collection of short two-player board games for iPhone: Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect 4, Quoridor, Hex, Hit & Blow and a word game. Share a six-digit room code or an invite link to play a friend online, pass one phone back and forth, or practice against a robot opponent that adapts to your level.

Every player has a hand-drawn Humation avatar built with humation-swift. You design it during onboarding, and it appears on the home screen, next to your opponent during a match, on the result card with the winner's crown, and in the friends list and pair history.

humation.usage: Player profile avatars on the home screen, in-match header, result card, friends list and pair history
